The '''saldi bush''' was a type of [[Bush/Legends|bush]] that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yavin 13/Legends|Yavin 13]]. It had a short lifespan, growing and dying within the space of a single [[growing season]].<ref name="GG2" />
